## Checklist

- [ ] Anything tied to a date, a person, or a semester is under `semesters/`, not `docs/`
- [ ] Names are kebab-case; dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`; folders follow `YYYY-term` and `YYYY-MM-DD-slug`
- [ ] Personal contact info, student IDs, home addresses, signatures, and photos of people are absent, or written consent is on file
- [ ] Rosters and attendance appear as counts only
- [ ] Unknowns are marked `[TBD]`, not guessed
- [ ] Any binding decision in this PR has an entry in `docs/01-governance/decision-log.md`
- [ ] Every file is under 1 MB
- [ ] `scripts/check.sh` passes locally, or I read the CI results and fixed what it found
